name: 2C-iBu
summary: 2C-iBu, or 2C-IB, also known as 4-isobutyl-2,5-dimethoxyphenethylamine or by its developmental code name ELE-02, is a serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist, serotonergic psychedelic, and anti-inflammatory drug which is under development for the treatment of inflammation. It is a member of the phenethylamine and 2C families of compounds.

pharmacology.text: 2C-iBu is a highly potent and robustly efficacious serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist. Its EC50 values are 1.3 nM for calcium mobilization and 57.5 nM for β-arrestin-2 recruitment, whereas its Emax values are 103% for calcium mobilization and 77% for β-arrestin-2 recruitment relative to serotonin.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen; Anti-inflammatory drug

uses.text: 2C-iBu, or 2C-IB, also known as 4-isobutyl-2,5-dimethoxyphenethylamine or by its developmental code name ELE-02, is a serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist, serotonergic psychedelic, and anti-inflammatory drug which is under development for the treatment of inflammation. The drug is being developed as a topical eye drop for treatment of inflammatory eye conditions.
